title: ManageAFK
description: with this PLUGIN you can customize the AFK in your server with style and with lots of features and optimization for no performance issues.
body:
![functions of the plugin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84ad6e3cb6dcb899a7662c60551cb18a5dc6df13.png)

**ManageAFK** is a PLUGIN that offers you lots of features for your server with **AFK** players!

**-** 💭Custom enter/leave messages\
**-** ⚒️Custom enter/leave commands\
**-** 🔌kick when afk for customizable time\
**-** 💾complete console logging\
**-** 🔰custom permission of the plugin\
**-** 🌐OP & NON-OP easy permissions\
**-** 🎆fireworks when returning from afk\
**-** ❗custom warning message before kick\
**-** ⌚custom time for afk, warning and kick\
**-** ✔️activate/disable all the features\
**-** 💊invulnerability while being afk\
**-** 🔗motionless while afk (can't disable)\
**-** 🔢high compatibility and tested a lot



![custom permissions of the plugin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/052e77beb9d56c0bdb5c2970af484312ca3195e9.png)

➡️We advise using a plugin like **LuckPerms** to assign this permissions to players.

**manageafk.use**    | Allows you to use **/manageafk afk**\
**manageafk.reload** | Allows you to use **/manageafk reload**\
**manageafk.help**   | Allows you to use **/manageafk help**\
**manageafk.admin**  | Whith this **you get all the permissions** excluded bypasses\
**manageafk.bypass.timeout** | Allows **bypassing the AFK timeout**\
**manageafk.bypass.kick** | Allows **bypassing the automatic KICK**\
**OP & NON-OP** | These are Minecraft default perms. **you can customize them in the config.yml**



![compatibilities of this plugin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a007687b00e29e673e79ba40af0fdddff3aec69.png)

**❗Important note❗**\
This plugin needs **PlaceholderAPI** to work properly!\
If **PlaceholderAPI** is **not installed** the plugin will **not start.**

**-** 🔢This plugin works from 1.17x to 1.21x (all the versions)\
**-** ✔️The plugin supports java version from 16 to 25 (older won't work)\
**-** 🎨This plugin uses a custom Gradient form. Check the Config.yml for the tutorial.\
**-** 🔰& colors, HEX colors and GRADIENTS are supported on this plugin.\
**-** 🎆Fireworks supports effects, colors, power and lots other. Check Config.yml.\
**-** 💊PlaceholderAPI extensions can be used in the messages of this plugin with no problems.



![commands of this plugin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c00bd4d97b355223b6d7dfe9a4ceb744e1297ba.png)

**/manageafk help**   📞Shows the help menu of the plugin\
**/manageafk reload** 🔄️reloads the plugin config.yml\
**/manageafk afk**    ⌚puts you in afk mode instantly\
**/manageafk list**   📅gives you a list of AFK players and time\
**/manageafk clear**  🛠️clears all afk states and the list with time
